status: specification acceptance scenarios; product implementation not tested

requirements.title: Offline open
requirements.scenario: Open selected entry/include files from bundled HTML with network disabled.
requirements.expected: Initial visible scene and explicit verification coverage; no server/fetch needed.

requirements.title: Spatial workarea
requirements.scenario: Navigate W4, expand/restore a view and follow an offscreen link.
requirements.expected: Authored placements unchanged; stable identities; only visible scene mounted.

requirements.title: Qualified names
requirements.scenario: Two included files define the same reference name and repeated display labels.
requirements.expected: Resolve by file-qualified identity; only entry workarea active.

requirements.title: Progressive drafts
requirements.scenario: Display unnamed/title-only/freeform and structured native ERD in one workarea.
requirements.expected: All legal draft forms shown; status, style, details and body mode independent.

requirements.title: Shared occurrences
requirements.scenario: Show two appearances of one definition with different local presentation.
requirements.expected: Shared content consistent; occurrence settings and focus survive culling.

requirements.title: Passive revisions
requirements.scenario: Stream replacement and ordered keyed updates with a schema change.
requirements.expected: Coherent revision vector; no keyed delta loss; no participation controls.

requirements.title: Stale evidence
requirements.scenario: Update data used by an Accepted scope while its verifier job is outstanding.
requirements.expected: Stored status unchanged; stale evidence marked; old result cannot clear marker.

requirements.title: Missing capability
requirements.scenario: Open an unsupported profile, then install its trusted compatible pack.
requirements.expected: Named placeholder preserves source; exact profile resumes without substitution.

requirements.title: Accessible inspection
requirements.scenario: Keyboard/search to an offscreen entity and inspect truncated cell/hidden field.
requirements.expected: Full semantic text reachable; focus survives scene patch; no dependence on SVG node presence.

requirements.title: Coherent capture
requirements.scenario: Export whole document while viewport is a small corner; then request missing adapter.
requirements.expected: Full declared scope and revision manifest; unsupported format is explicit.

requirements.title: Instance isolation
requirements.scenario: Two viewers share a runtime; a third uses another runtime with different packs.
requirements.expected: Per-view camera; no global registry/style mutation; one destroy does not affect other leases.

requirements.title: Read-only disposal
requirements.scenario: Navigate/select/preview/capture then destroy twice.
requirements.expected: No source/status changes; no imported command service; owned resources released.

requirements.title: Composition
requirements.scenario: Attach and detach designer on an existing populated viewer.
requirements.expected: Same runtime/scene/camera; detached viewer read-only and usable.

requirements.title: Native creation
requirements.scenario: Select DDN/ERD, Draft and handdrawn; add first entity without coordinates.
requirements.expected: Centered in active viewport; <table> placeholder; independent status/style.

requirements.title: Provisional title
requirements.scenario: Edit display title and reference name separately; choose scoped font.
requirements.expected: Reference uniqueness checked; display labels legal; only selected typography scope set.

requirements.title: Draft conversion
requirements.scenario: Convert field-list and explicit header-table drafts with empty/quoted cells.
requirements.expected: Explicit interpretation; no guessed header loss; original text recoverable.

requirements.title: Field visibility
requirements.scenario: Select Name/Domain/Key then change local table headers.
requirements.expected: Menus derive from correct schema; visibility preserves values; provisional domain reusable.

requirements.title: Defaults
requirements.scenario: Change and reset an inherited typed setting under two different methods.
requirements.expected: File > scoped CSS > standard; reset omits property; no foreign rule/style leakage.

requirements.title: Relations
requirements.scenario: Create/reconnect members and attempt a disallowed role/endpoint.
requirements.expected: Exact profile contracts enforced; invalid command diagnostic; no partial commit.

requirements.title: Atomic edit
requirements.scenario: Prepare a multi-file rename then change a read dependency before commit.
requirements.expected: Conflict returned; no partial patches/model mutation; reprepare required.

requirements.title: Source preservation
requirements.scenario: Edit visually around notes/comments/quotes/skipped cells; type broken source.
requirements.expected: Untouched formatting and omissions retained; broken buffer recoverable; affected scene marked stale.

requirements.title: Gesture transaction
requirements.scenario: Drag/resize with pointer cancellation and IME text entry while data updates.
requirements.expected: One gesture commit; cancel restores preview; text composition and local drafts preserved.

requirements.title: History
requirements.scenario: Undo/redo content edits to budget then attempt undo of lifecycle transition.
requirements.expected: Bounded patch history; no return to Draft or authority bypass; checkpoint retained.

requirements.title: Lifecycle
requirements.scenario: Review incomplete/complete scopes, accept with event, reopen with and without authority.
requirements.expected: Only eligible explicit transitions; acceptance user/time; protected changes require reopening.

requirements.title: Local save/recovery
requirements.scenario: Save dirty multi-file state, deny optional storage, exhaust recovery quota.
requirements.expected: Sources retained; downloadable artifacts; no false claim of durable save.

requirements.title: Profile editing
requirements.scenario: For every route create/edit its admitted roles, metadata and relations.
requirements.expected: Registered typed controls plus exact command descriptors; no generic placeholder counted as coverage.

requirements.title: AI/host proposal
requirements.scenario: Supply a proposed source or model command through a host adapter.
requirements.expected: Same prepare/verify/authority/commit path; no automatic acceptance or execution.

requirements.title: Headless
requirements.scenario: Import verifier under Node/cooperative executor without DOM or browser globals.
requirements.expected: No viewer/editor/renderer dependency or semantic rendering call.

requirements.title: Input equivalence
requirements.scenario: Check decoded source set and equivalent normalized snapshot.
requirements.expected: Same rule outcomes/targets at same scope/purpose/version; source spans where supplied.

requirements.title: Diagnostics
requirements.scenario: Supply malformed indentation, duplicate names, wrong endpoints and invalid values.
requirements.expected: Specific file/span/code; no mutation or automatic repair.

requirements.title: Draft distinction
requirements.scenario: Verify sparse native draft structurally, then request physical-schema review.
requirements.expected: Structural validity not confused with complete review; missing facts not zero/false.

requirements.title: Stage coverage
requirements.scenario: Request structure only, full review and publication with missing metrics.
requirements.expected: Explicit check level/coverage; no unrequested success; missing evidence incomplete/unsupported.

requirements.title: Exact profiles
requirements.scenario: Replay positive/negative witnesses for all 151 retained profiles.
requirements.expected: Full declared bounded rules/limits preserved; foreign method semantics separate.

requirements.title: Global scope
requirements.scenario: Hide/offload a graph node participating in a cycle or second root.
requirements.expected: Global rule sees full closure or reports incomplete; visible subset cannot pass.

requirements.title: Dependency cache
requirements.scenario: Change comment, cell, shared domain and profile version in turn.
requirements.expected: Only safe caches reused; dynamic dependencies tracked; full-scope rules invalidated when required.

requirements.title: Stale reports
requirements.scenario: Complete old work after relevant revision/font/purpose change.
requirements.expected: Stale result not applied; unrelated source-only edits can remap locations safely.

requirements.title: Transition eligibility
requirements.scenario: Ask about Draft exit, review, acceptance and authorized reopening.
requirements.expected: Eligibility only; verifier never sets status; offline identity limits explicit.

requirements.title: Budget/cancel
requirements.scenario: Interrupt expensive check or exceed a work/memory budget.
requirements.expected: Exactly one terminal outcome; checked coverage retained; never false valid.

requirements.title: Unknown pack
requirements.scenario: Load unsupported language/profile/default or partial provider.
requirements.expected: Explicit missing capability and preserved source; no nearest-profile substitution.

requirements.title: Publication independence
requirements.scenario: Check semantic model without renderer; later supply explicit metric evidence.
requirements.expected: Semantic pass independent; publication eligibility tied to supplied current evidence.

requirements.title: Contract versions
requirements.scenario: Load exact language/default/profile versions across modules.
requirements.expected: Single codex authority; incompatibility diagnosed before pack activation.

requirements.title: Standalone editions
requirements.scenario: Open all three HTML utilities offline, then embed ESM entries.
requirements.expected: No backend/CDN required; local input works; complete edition contains all151 profiles.

requirements.title: Worker equivalence
requirements.scenario: Run same request in worker and fallback, then kill worker mid-job.
requirements.expected: Equivalent semantics; recovery from committed snapshot; stale work discarded.

requirements.title: Source/model ownership
requirements.scenario: Commit prepared command and source edit against changing revision.
requirements.expected: Atomic coherent source/model; explicit incomplete buffer, no competing authoritative stores.

requirements.title: Font/style metrics
requirements.scenario: Change CSS font under explicit file settings and delay font readiness.
requirements.expected: Precedence retained; matching geometry remeasured; no silent mismatch.

requirements.title: Restricted document content
requirements.scenario: Load Markdown/URLs/SVG containing executable payloads.
requirements.expected: Render as permitted data or diagnose; no executable document import/network fetch.

requirements.title: Resource provider
requirements.scenario: Resolve includes/assets from selected map; omit one; disconnect passive provider.
requirements.expected: File identity retained; missing/stale state explicit; no implicit disk/network access.

requirements.title: Output capability
requirements.scenario: Capture content/viewport with draft/stale/missing asset policies.
requirements.expected: Correct revision/fidelity manifest; no format substitution or accidental publication.

requirements.title: Performance
requirements.scenario: Execute W1–W8 under pinned measurement protocol.
requirements.expected: Publish timings/size/operation counts and failures against declared targets.

requirements.title: Disposal isolation
requirements.scenario: Destroy mixed viewer/designer/verifier instances in varying order.
requirements.expected: No global leaks; shared leases honored; final runtime releases workers and resources.

requirements.title: Edition boundary
requirements.scenario: Consume server-supplied revisions without installing collaboration code.
requirements.expected: Passive viewing works; interactive collaboration/managed services optional closed providers.

requirements.title: Requirement trace
requirements.scenario: Ship every retained route with tests for render/rules/defaults/edit roundtrip.
requirements.expected: 151 exact profile routes covered; specification route alone is not product evidence.
